name: Sim
description: Builds agent workflows on a visual canvas and ships each one as a versioned REST endpoint or MCP tool, connecting 1,000+ integrations and every major LLM.

skills.name: Visual Workflow Builder
skills.description: Builds agent workflows on a drag-and-drop canvas, or conversationally and in code, wiring LLM blocks to tools and integrations.

skills.name: API Workflow Deployment
skills.description: Deploys a workflow as a versioned REST endpoint supporting synchronous, streaming, and asynchronous execution modes.

skills.name: MCP Tool Deployment
skills.description: Exposes deployed workflows as MCP tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other clients, gated by API key or left public.

skills.name: Knowledge Base Ingestion
skills.description: Ingests files, documents, and structured tables into workspace knowledge bases that agents search at run time.

skills.name: Run Monitoring And Logs
skills.description: Tracks workflow runs, logs, schedules, and activity in one workspace so you can debug executions after they finish.
